context.problem_statement: Decompose portfolio excess returns using the Fama-French 3-factor model: R_portfolio - R_f = alpha + beta_mkt*(R_mkt - R_f) + beta_smb*SMB + beta_hml*HML + epsilon. Run OLS regression of portfolio excess returns on the three factors. Report: (1) factor loadings (betas) for each factor, (2) alpha (Jensen's alpha, annualized), (3) R-squared of the factor model, (4) t-statistics and p-values for each coefficient, (5) unexplained idiosyncratic risk (std of residuals).
context.expert_knowledge: Use statsmodels.api.OLS for regression. Fama-French factors: MKT-RF = market excess return (market risk premium), SMB = Small Minus Big (size factor), HML = High Minus Low (value factor). Positive alpha indicates outperformance after controlling for factor exposures. High R-squared (>0.9) means most return variation explained by factors. Annualized alpha = monthly_alpha * 12.
